License: NIST software statement (public-domain style: use, copy, modify, distribute; keep the notice; acknowledge NIST)
for h5wasm itself, plus the HDF5 library's BSD-style license (The HDF Group) — both in LICENSE (the package's LICENSE.txt).
Files copied unchanged from the tarball: dist/esm/hdf5_hl.js (ES module API) and dist/esm/hdf5_util.js (Emscripten
module with the WebAssembly embedded, so there is no separate .wasm). The same two files run in a browser worker and in Node.
Used by PartCraft's CraftScript io (assets/apps/partcraft/dev/cs-lib-io.js) for .h5 load/save, loaded only when an HDF5
file is opened or saved.
